MAINSTREAMING SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOALS
SUSTAINABILITY
UPDATE •Cumulatively, loans amounting to KShs. 447 billion
have been screened for ESDD compliance since 2015.
•In 2019 the Group adopted SDG 13 on Climate Action in
line with the collective commitment to climate action by the
founding banks of the recently launched Principles of
Sustainable Banking.
•Commitment to be a carbon neutral business by 2028.
•26 staff engagements in integrating Sustainability in the
new 2020 – 2022 Beyond Banking Strategy have been
conducted reaching 50% of the total Group staff.
